title: Norwegian Oat Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting Norwegian-inspired casserole made with steel-cut oats and topped with vibrant vegetables.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté the onion and carrots in oil over medium heat until softened.
Add the grated zucchini, flour, salt, and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the oats and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Serve warm, garnished with additional grated carrots if desired.
